```{python}
import pandas as pd
import glob

files = glob.glob(r"C:\Users\patbe\OneDrive\Documents\Sports Analytics\Tennis\data/*")

data = []

for file in files:
    csv = pd.read_csv(file)
    data.append(csv)
    

full_data = pd.concat(data)
full_data.to_csv("match_data.csv")
```
